answer.reason: The verses tell of Balak's attempt to hire Balaam to curse Israel and its failure, which is more than the summary states.

clauses.english: sent messengers to Balaam to call him to curse Israel
clauses.quote: Come now therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people

clauses.english: was angered when Balaam blessed Israel three times instead of cursing them
clauses.quote: I called thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast altogether blessed them these three times.

doubts: REV 2:14 spells the name Balac and speaks of the doctrine of Balaam, so it was left out; MIC 6:5 and JDG 11:25 only recall him, and JOS 24:9 adds warring against Israel, which the narrative in Numbers does not state, so it was left out.
NUM 22:5-6 are not marked as naming Balak but are the verses that state the sending of messengers; the marked NUM 22:7 and 22:16 show it.
